name: A New Challenge
Text: After you replace this story, take all success tokens for each player and redistribute them between the revealed stories. No more than 4 success tokens can be assigned to any story on either player's side.

name: Alexander Pallas
Subtitle: Wrong Place, Right Time
Text: Response: After a character is destroyed, ready Alexander Pallas.

name: Apeirophobia
Text: Play during your operations phase. Action: Choose a non-ANCIENT ONE character. That character's controller chooses to either have that character to go insane or discards X cards from his hand. X is the skill of the chosen character.

name: Arcane Tampering
Faction: The Order of the Silver Twilight
Text: Response: After a character exhausts to trigger or pay the cost of an effect, its controller must sacrifice that character.

name: Archaeology Interns
Text: Response: After you play Archeology Interns from your hand, draw 2 cards. Then put 1 card from your hand on top of your deck.

name: Attack Dogs
Text: Attach to a character. Attached character gains # for each CREATURE card you control.

name: Aziz Chatuluka
Subtitle: A Danger to all Mankind
Text: Action: Sacrifice Aziz Chatuluka and drain all your undrained domains to put an ANCIENT ONE character into play from your hand. At the end of the phase, if the ANCIENT ONE character is still in play, place it on the top of your deck.

name: Blackmarket Artifact
Text: Action: Exhaust Blackmarket Artifact to choose a character. That character gains WILLPOWER and $ $ until the end of the phase.

name: Breaking the Ward
Text: Attach to an opponent's support card. Response: After attached card's ability is triggered, discard one card from the top of your deck to copy the attached card's effect without paying any costs. You choose all targets of the copied effect.

name: Burden Bearer
Text: Disrupt: After you win a @ struggle at a story where Burden Bearer was committed alone, discard a success token from that story.

name: Canopic Jar
Subtitle: Vessel of Souls
Text: After Canopic Jar leaves play shuffle it into its owner's deck. Response: Exhaust Canopic Jar to attach a character just destroyed to it. You may exhaust Canopic Jar and discard a card attached to it to trigger that card’s ability without paying any cost.

name: Chaos Unleashed
Text: Choose 1 domain you control. Take all resource attached to it and place them into your hand. Replace those resource with and equal number of cards off the top of your deck.

name: Child of Argus
Text: When Child of Argus leaves play, search the top three cards of your deck for a character, reveal it, and place it in your hand. Then shuffle your deck.

name: Come the Dreamtime
Text: After you replace this story, rearrange any revealed stories, leaving all success tokens on the board in place.

name: Congress of the Keys
Text: Each player must shuffle his hand into his deck and then draw the same number of cards. Then the player who won this story draws 1 card.

name: Dark Sarcophagus
Subtitle: Holder of Unearthly Remains
Text: After Dark Sarcophagus leaves play, shuffle it into its owner's deck. Action: Exhaust Dark Sarcophagus and play X to choose an opponent. Reveal the top X cards of that opponent's deck, then discard all cards that cost X or more. All cards not discarded are added to his hand.

name: Deciphered History
Text: Response: After an opponent places a success token on a story where you have 1 or more committed characters, discard that success token.

name: Deranged Sailor
Text: Response: After you succeed at a story that Deranged Sailor is committed to, drive Deranged Sailor insane to make all ready characters go insane.

name: Desertification
Text: Attach to a LOCATION support card. Forced Response: After the attached LOCATION ability is triggered, the controller of that card must destroy a resource he controls.

name: Diligent Study
Text: Action: Each of your STUDENT characters gets +2 skill and $ until the end of the phase.

name: Dirk Sharpe
Subtitle: Acquisitions
Faction: The Order of the Silver Twilight
Text: Action: Pay 2 to put Dirk Sharpe into play from your hand exhausted and committed to a story with 1 or more characters already committed.

name: Disc of Itzamna
Subtitle: Protective Amulet
Text: Attach to a character. Attached character cannot be the target of triggered effects. After Disc of Itzamna leaves play, shuffle it into its owner's deck.

name: Doctor Marama Riwhi
Subtitle: Warrior of the Mind
Text: Disrupt: When a character committed to the same story as Doctor Marama Riwhi would go insane, you may instead make any other eligible character you control go insane.

name: Dr. Henshaw
Subtitle: Too Close to the Truth
Text: Disrupt: When Dr. Henshaw would go insane, ready all other [The Agency] characters committed to the same story.

name: Eater from the Depths
Subtitle: It Hungers
Text: Forced Response: After a character committed to the same story as Eater from the Depths goes insane, Eater from the Depths gains # # until the end of the phase.

name: Eliot Ness' Handcuffs
Subtitle: A New Symbol of Justice
Text: Attach to a non-ANCIENT ONE character. Attached character loses all keywords. After Eliot Ness' Handcuffs leaves play, shuffle it into its owner's deck.

name: Enslaved Yeti
Text: Action: While Enslaved Yeti is committed to a story, wound it to blank the text boxes of all other non-ANCIENT ONE characters committed to the same story, until the end of the phase,

name: Eon Chart
Subtitle: Map of the Spheres
Faction: The Order of the Silver Twilight
Text: Attach to a character you control. Action: Add an additional story struggle of your choice to 1 story until end of the phase. At the end of the phase, sacrifice attached character and shuffle Eon Chart into its owner's deck. Limit once per phase.

name: Erasmus Manor
Subtitle: The Necromancer
Faction: The Order of the Silver Twilight
Text: Forced Response: After a character you control leaves play, Erasmus Manor gains # % until the end of the turn.

name: Eryn Cochwyn
Subtitle: Curious and Precocious
Text: Response: After you win an % struggle at a story to which Eryn Cochwyn is committed, drive her insane to place an additional success token on that story.

name: Even Here She Dwells
Text: Action: If your opponent has more characters in play than you, reveal the top 5 cards of your deck and place any CULTIST or MONSTER characters into your hand, returning the rest of the cards to the top of your deck in any order.

name: Expert Cartographer
Text: If you control any LOCATION support cards, Expert Cartographer gains FAST and TOUGHNESS +1.

name: Family of Fishers
Text: Family of Fishers gains @ if every character you control committed to the same story has the DEEP ONE subtype.

name: Federal Vault
Text: Action: Pay 1 to choose a non-LOCATION support card in your discard pile and place it on top of your deck.

name: Forcing the Truth
Text: Action: Exhaust 1 non-ANCIENT ONE character. Then ready 1 non-ANCIENT ONE character.

name: Forms of the Ether
Text: Action: Choose a card attached to a domain as a resource. Put that card into its owner’s hand  and attach Forms of the Ether to that domain (counts as a > resource)

name: Fortifying Ouzo
Text: Attach to a character. Attached character gains WILLPOWER and #. Action: Pay 1 to move Fortifying Ouzo to a different character.

name: Guardian Beast
Subtitle: Servant of Serapis
Text: Attach to a character. Attached character gains INVULNERABLE. While attached character is committed to a story, that story gains:

name: Harlan Earnstone
Subtitle: Historical Theorist
Text: Response: After you win a struggle by 2 or more icons, exhaust Harlan Earnstone to move 1 success token of yours from 1 story to any other story.

name: Heart of the Labyrinth
Text: Each player names a card type. The player to his left must then choose a card of that type he controls and return it to hand.

name: Hidden Agenda
Faction: The Order of the Silver Twilight
Text: Action: When this phase ends, immediately repeat this phase.

name: Horrific Light
Text: Action: Wound a character you control to destroy a character with lower skill than the character you wounded.

name: Hound of Dragons
Text: Response: After an opponent wins a struggle at a story, choose a character committed to that story. Place that character on the top of its owner's deck.

name: Ice Shaft
Text: Action: Sacrifice Ice SHaft to choose and destroy a character with skill 3 or lower.

name: Initiate of Huang Hun
Faction: The Order of the Silver Twilight
Text: Response: After Initiate of Huang Hun enters play, each player returns a character he controls to its owner's hand if able.

name: Inspector Li Flint
Subtitle: With Pride and Care
Text: Action: Choose a subtype. Until the end of the phase, Inspector Li Flint gains a # for each opposing character with that subtype committed to the same story. Limit once per phase.

name: Jacques Artois
Subtitle: Surprisingly Insightful
Text: Forced Response: After a character you control is wounded, Jacques Artois gains # % until end of the phase.

name: Jade Salesman
Text: Raise the cost for each player to play ATTACHMENT support cards by 1. Disrupt: Sacrifice Jade Salesman to prevent an ATTACHMENT support card from being attached. Destroy that ATTACHMENT instead.

name: Jaguar Warrior
Text: Response: After Jaguar Warrior is wounded, search your deck for a card named Jaguar Warrior, reveal it, and place it in your hand. Then shuffle your deck.

name: James Crusher
Subtitle: Short Fused
Text: Action: Choose a non-ANCIENT ONE character committed to the same story as James Crusher. Uncommit James Crusher to uncommit the chosen character.

name: Jiang Shi
Subtitle: The Restless Dead
Text: Disrupt: Before you resolve a @ struggle, pay 1 to commit Jiang Shi to that story without exhausting it. If Jiang Shi is already committed to another story, uncommit it.

name: John & Jessie Burke
Subtitle: Relentless in Pursuit
Text: Response: After  a character committed to a story is wounded, exhaust John & Jessie Burke to wound a character committed to the same story.

name: Kau'uli Warriors
Text: Response: After an opponent destroys a character due to a # struggle at a story where Kau'uli Warriors is committed, search your deck for a card named Kau'uli Warriors. Then shuffle your deck and put Kau'uli Warriors on top of your deck.

name: Key-seeker
Text: Response: After you win a $ struggle by 2 or more icons, exhaust Key-seeker to return the topmost card of your discard pile to your hand.

name: Khopesh of the Abyss
Subtitle: Manifested Malice
Text: Attach to a character you control. Attached character gains TOUGHNESS +1. After Kopesh of the Abyss leaves play, shuffle it into its owner's deck. Action: Wound attached character to choose a character. That character takes 1 wound.

name: Lady Lu Chu
Subtitle: Death Follows
Text: When Lady Lu Chu is the only character you control at a story, she gains FAST and # #.

name: Lethargic Miasma
Text: Attach to a character. Attached character may not ready. Attached character gains "Action: Pay 1 and drive attached character insane."

name: Living Ink
Subtitle: A Questionable Boon
Text: Attach to a character you control. After Living Ink leaves play, shuffle it into its owner's deck. Action: Pay 1 to give attached character @ # # #. Attached character is destroyed at the end of the phase.

name: Magarta Kiss
Subtitle: Starry-eyed Lover
Text: Action: Pay X to reveal the top X cards of your deck. Place any ANCIENT ONE cards into your hand and the remaining cards on the bottom of your deck in any order.

name: Magnetic Spike
Text: Action: Return all non-RELIC support cards in play to the top of its owner's deck in any order.

name: Magnus Stiles
Subtitle: Blood Mage
Faction: The Order of the Silver Twilight
Text: Action: When you control more SORCERER characters than any opponent, sacrifice a SORCERER character to put a success token on a story. Limit once per turn.

name: Mask of Rakinui
Subtitle: Symbol of Power
Text: Attach to a character you control. While attached character is committed to a story during your turn, you decide the order of struggles resolve at that story. After Mask of Rakinui leaves play, shuffle it into it's owner's deck.

name: Mask of Sthenelus
Subtitle: Image of Nobility
Text: Attach to a character. Attached character gainst WILLPOWER and INVULNERABILITY. After Mask of Sthenelus leaves play, shuffle it into its owner's deck.

name: Master of Amulets
Text: Action: Discard a card from your hand to choose an insane character. Restore and ready that character, and take control of it until the end of the phase.

name: Master of the Myths
Faction: The Order of the Silver Twilight
Text: Action: Pay 1 to put Master of the Myths into play from your hand. If Master of the Myths is still in paly at the end of the phase, return it to your hand.

name: Mi-Go Observer
Text: Response: After a MI-GO character is destroyed, reveal the top 5 cards of your deck. Put any revealed MI-GO characters into your hand and put the rest of the cards on the bottom of your deck in any order.

name: Mi-Go Skull
Subtitle: Revered Remnant
Text: Attach to a character you control. Attached character gainst the MI-GO subtype. Your MI-GO characters gain @. After Mi-Go Skull leaves play, shuffle it into its owner's deck.

name: Monophobia
Text: Attach to a character. Attached character loses WILLPOWER and cannot commit to stories alone.

name: Mr. David Pan
Subtitle: Red Pole
Text: When resolving struggles at a story that Mr. David Pan is committed to, count the total skill of all participating characters instead of the icons to determine the winner of each struggle.

name: Nassor
Subtitle: Alamut Operative
Text: Response: After all players have finished committing characters to stories, choose a non-ANCIENT ONE character committed to the same story as Nassor. The character's controller chooses to either uncommit that character or sacrifice it after all stories resolve.

name: Naval Tactics
Text: Action: All characters with skill X or lower do not count their printed icons until the end of the phase.

name: Necessary Evil
Faction: The Order of the Silver Twilight
Text: Action: Sacrifice a non-ANCIENT ONE character committed to a story. All characters you control committed to that same story gain the icons of the sacrificed character until the end of the phase.

name: Nigel St. James
Subtitle: Lodge Recruiter
Faction: The Order of the Silver Twilight
Text: Disrupt: When a character you control would be destroyed, ready Nigel St. James to instead attach that character to a domain you control as a resource.

name: Obsessive Sycophant
Text: Action: Exhaust Obsessive Sycophant to choose a character you control. That character gains $ $ until the end of the phase.

name: Ophidian Blight
Text: Action: Choose a story. Until the end of the phase, that story gains: @ @. Any player may sacrifice a character to cancel this effect.

name: Out of Season Monsoon
Text: Response: Destroy a LOCATION support card that just triggered an effect.

name: Outback Poacher
Text: Response: After a MONSTER or CREATURE character is destroyed, draw 1 card.

name: Painter of Delusion
Text: Disrupt: Drive a LUNATIC character insane to cancel a triggered character ability.

name: Palpable Unhappiness
Text: Action: Choose a story. All characters committed to that story have their skill lowered.

name: Pawn Broker
Text: Action: Pay 1 and discard a card from your hand to draw a card.

name: Pervasive Silence
Text: Attach to a non-ANCIENT ONE character. Attached character loses $ $ % %.

name: Phoebe Kotas
Subtitle: Impertinent and Inquisitive
Text: Phoebe Kotas does not exhaust to commit to stories.

name: Premature Detonation
Text: Play during your story phase after all players have committed characters. Action: Exhaust all non-ANCIENT ONE characters in play.

name: Professor Sam Campbell
Subtitle: Erudite Archeologist
Text: When Professor Sam Campbell is committed to a story, @ struggles at that story are resolved by counting $ icons.

name: Reclaimed Servant
Text: If Reclaimed Servant is exhausted at the end of your turn, discard 1 card from the top of your deck. If Reclaimed Servant is ready at the end of an opponent's turn, discard 2 cards from the top of that opponent's deck.

name: Recovered Icebreaker
Text: Action: Exhaust an _ character to search your discard pile for an ATTACHMENT support card and attach it to that character.

name: Ritual of Bellephar
Text: Action: Choose a domain. The owner of that domain discards 1 card from the top of his deck for each resource attached to that domain.

name: Scylla's Well
Subtitle: Unfathomable Depths
Text: Attach to a LOCATION you control. Attached LOCATION becomes a character with @ @ # #, TOUGHNESS +2 and a skill equal to its cost. After Scylla's Well leaves play, shuffle it into tis owner's deck.

name: Seeker of the Songlines
Text: Action: Exhaust Seeker of the Songlines to commit it to a story where there is at least 1 other committed character. You may only trigger this ability during the story phase.

name: Shriven and Resolute
Text: Attach to a character. Response: After a character is wounded, ready attached character.

name: Silent Mover
Text: Action: Pay 1 to ready The Silent Mover.

name: Song of Charybdis
Text: Action: Choose a player. That player reveals the top X cards of his deck. Choose any number of cards revealed and place them on the bottom of that player's deck. Return the rest of the cards to the top deck in any order.

name: Sons of Hermes
Text: Action: Pay 1 and exhaust a CRIMINAL character you control to ready a CRIMINAL character.

name: Stygian Eye
Subtitle: It Seduces with Promises of Power
Text: Attach to a non-ANCIENT ONE character. Take control of attached character. After Stygian Eye leaves play, shuffle it into its owner's deck. Forced Response: After attached character is readied, it goes insane.

name: Taste of Lifeblood
Text: Response: After a character is destroyed, refresh a domain.

name: Temple of R'lyeh
Subtitle: Frozen in Time
Text: Action: Sacrifice a [ character to choose an opponent. That opponent must sacrifice a character he controls.

name: The 9th Plague
Text: Each player sacrifices all of his characters committed to this story.

name: The Betrayer
Subtitle: Playing All Sides
Text: If The Betrayer is able to commit to a story, he must commit to a story. Response: After The Betrayer is committed to a story, ready him to have each player reveal the top card of his deck. Then you choose whether each player discards that card or returns it to the top of his deck.

name: The Chthonian Stone
Subtitle: Stygian Waymark
Text: After The Chthonian Stone leaves play, shuffle it into its owner's deck. Response: After a character you control is destroyed, exhaust The Chthonian Stone to put a character into play from your hand with a lower printed cost than the destroyed character.

name: The Cult of Bathos
Subtitle: Near Mindless Devotation
Text: Lower the cost of the first DEEP ONE character you play this phase by 1 for each DEEP ONE character you have in play ( to a minimum of 1).

name: The Deodand
Subtitle: Cutting Threads
Faction: The Order of the Silver Twilight
Text: Attach to a non-ANCIENT ONE character. After The Deodand leaves play, shuffle it into its owner's deck.Forced Response: At the end of the phase in which attached character is committed to a story, destroy that character.

name: The Doorway
Subtitle: Extra-dimensional Exit
Faction: The Order of the Silver Twilight
Text: Disrupt: Before an effect would resolve, exhaust The Doorway to choose a character you control that is committed to a story and return it to its owner’s hand.

name: The Forgotten Explorer
Text: Forced Response: After you opponent has committed characters, choose the story with the fewest committed characters, minimum of 1. The Forgotten Explorer exhausts and then commits to that story.

name: The Guzheng
Subtitle: Item of Ill Fortune
Text: Attach to a character. Attached character's skill is reduced to 0. After The Guzheng leaves play, shuffle it into its owner's deck. Forced Response: When attached character uncommits from a story, it goes insane.

name: The Heirloom
Text: Each player may search his deck for a support card, reveal it, and put that card into his hand. Then each player shuffles his deck.

name: The Large Man
Subtitle: Shorn But Patient
Text: Forced Response: After a player succeeds at a story, he must discard 2 cards from the top of his deck. Action: Exhaust The Large Man to put the topmost event card in your discard pile into your hand. Limit once per phase.

name: The Musk Crow's Wind
Text: Action: Choose 1 non-ANCIENT ONE character controlled by each player with cost X. Each chosen character is returned to its owner's hand.

name: The Opened Door
Text: Each player may take any number of cards from his hand and exchange them with an equal number of resources attached to a single domain he controls.

name: The Red Threshold
Text: Response: After you succeed at a story without losing any struggles, return a character you control to your hand. Then resolve the effects of any story in any player's won pile.

name: The Sanguine Watcher
Subtitle: He Sees What Is Not There
Text: Action: Pay X to look at the top X cards of an opponent's deck. Return those cards to the top of that deck in any order.

name: The Second Chancers
Subtitle: Doing Bad for Good
Text: Response: After you play The Second Chancers from your hand, wound all other characters with TOUGHNESS.

name: The Second Dragon
Text: Each player may choose a non-unique character he controls and search his deck for any number of cards with the same title. Put those cards into play. Then each player shuffles his deck.

name: The Seventh Gate
Text: Search the story deck and choose 1 story card. Resolve that story’s effect and then place it into your won pile only if you have won The Seventh Gate. Then, shuffle The Seventh Gate into the story deck.

name: The Spirit of Mania
Subtitle: Breaker of Minds
Text: Forced Response: After you have won a story that The Spirit of Mania is committed to, all characters committed to that same story go insane.

name: The Three Listeners
Subtitle: Ardent Supporters
Faction: The Order of the Silver Twilight
Text: If you have fewer cards in hand than each opponent, The Three Listeners gain $ %.

name: Thorough Search
Text: Action: Shuffle all ATTACHMENT support cards in your discard pile back into your deck.

name: Timely Intervention
Text: Action: No event cards can be played until the end of the phase.

name: Tunnel Lurker
Text: Forced Response: After Tunnel Lurker commits to a story, each player must discard 1 card from the top of his deck for each other character he has committed.

name: Tzu San Niang
Subtitle: Like A Ghost
Text: Forced Response: When you succeed at a story to which Tzu San Niang is committed, return all characters committed to that story to their owners' hands.

name: Unforseen Setback
Text: Attach to a character. Response: After an opponent succeeds at a story, wound attached character.

name: Vaage Randers
Subtitle: Master of Tactics
Text: When Vaage Randers is committed to a story, # struggles are resolved counting % icons.

name: Vacant Servant
Faction: The Order of the Silver Twilight
Text: Attach to a character. Attached character gains $ $. Disrupt: If you win an $ struggle at a story to which attached character is committed, sacrifice Vacant Servant to refresh 1 domain instead of readying a character.

name: Village of Ash
Text: Each player choose one story card that he has won (except this one) and shuffles it into the story deck. Then, shuffle all RELIC cards in play into their owners' decks.

name: Voice of the Jungle
Text: Attach to a story card. Characters committed to attached story cannot be uncommited until it is won.

name: WIthin the Ice
Text: Return all characters committed to this story to their owners' hands.

name: Wooden Homunculus
Text: Disrupt: When Wooden Homunculus would be destroyed, instead place it face down as a new domain and attach the top card of your deck to it as a resource.

name: Written in Blood
Subtitle: Unbreakable Contract
Text: Attach to a non-ANCIENT ONE character. After Written in Blood enters your discard pile, shuffle it into your deck. Action: Pay 1 to uncommit attached character if you control any } characters at the same story.
